raw:
"OAK: Oh, for Pete's sake…
So pushy, as always.\p{B_PLAYER_NAME}.\pYou've never had a POKéMON battle
before, have you?\pA POKéMON battle is when TRAINERS
pit their POKéMON against each\lother.\p"
source:
OAK: Oh, for Pete's sake…
So pushy, as always.\p{B_PLAYER_NAME}.\pYou've never had a POKéMON battle
before, have you?\pA POKéMON battle is when TRAINERS
pit their POKéMON against each\lother.\p

raw:
"OAK: Hm…
How disappointing…\pIf you win, you earn prize money,
and your POKéMON grow.\pBut if you lose, {B_PLAYER_NAME}, you end
up paying prize money…\pHowever, since you had no warning
this time, I'll pay for you.\pBut things won't be this way once
you step outside these doors.\pThat's why you must strengthen your
POKéMON by battling wild POKéMON.\p"
source:
OAK: Hm…
How disappointing…\pIf you win, you earn prize money,
and your POKéMON grow.\pBut if you lose, {B_PLAYER_NAME}, you end
up paying prize money…\pHowever, since you had no warning
this time, I'll pay for you.\pBut things won't be this way once
you step outside these doors.\pThat's why you must strengthen your
POKéMON by battling wild POKéMON.\p

raw: "OAK: Inflicting damage on the foe\nis the key to any battle.\p"
source: OAK: Inflicting damage on the foe\nis the key to any battle.\p

raw: "OAK: Keep your eyes on your\nPOKéMON's HP.\pIt will faint if the HP drops to\n“0.”\p"
source: OAK: Keep your eyes on your\nPOKéMON's HP.\pIt will faint if the HP drops to\n“0.”\p

raw: "OAK: Lowering the foe's stats\nwill put you at an advantage.\p"
source: OAK: Lowering the foe's stats\nwill put you at an advantage.\p

raw: "OAK: No! There's no running away\nfrom a TRAINER POKéMON battle!\p"
source: OAK: No! There's no running away\nfrom a TRAINER POKéMON battle!\p

raw: "The TRAINER that makes the other\nTRAINER's POKéMON faint by lowering\ltheir HP to “0,” wins.\p"
source: The TRAINER that makes the other\nTRAINER's POKéMON faint by lowering\ltheir HP to “0,” wins.\p

raw: "But rather than talking about it,\nyou'll learn more from experience.\pTry battling and see for yourself.\p"
source: But rather than talking about it,\nyou'll learn more from experience.\pTry battling and see for yourself.\p

raw: "OAK: Hm! Excellent!\pIf you win, you earn prize money,\nand your POKéMON will grow!\pBattle other TRAINERS and make\nyour POKéMON strong!\p"
source: OAK: Hm! Excellent!\pIf you win, you earn prize money,\nand your POKéMON will grow!\pBattle other TRAINERS and make\nyour POKéMON strong!\p

raw: "The tides run low tonight.\nSurf south, find the shrine,\nthen climb Mutrid's tower."
source: The tides run low tonight.\nSurf south, find the shrine,\nthen climb Mutrid's tower.
translation: {JPN}こんやは しおが ひく。\nなみのりで みなみの ほこらへ。\nそのあと ミュートリッドの とうへ。

raw: "The Shadow Generator is silent.\nThe wish is mended."
source: The Shadow Generator is silent.\nThe wish is mended.
translation: {JPN}ダークそうちは とまった。\nねがいは もとのすがたに。

raw: "Purify one Shadow at the\nshrine, then report back to\nPROF. ASSISTANT."
source: Purify one Shadow at the\nshrine, then report back to\nPROF. ASSISTANT.
translation: {JPN}ほこらで ダークポケモンを\n1たい リライブし\nはかせの じょしゅに ほうこく。

raw: "The sky is open. Now snag\nfive Shadows and return to\nPROF. ASSISTANT."
source: The sky is open. Now snag\nfive Shadows and return to\nPROF. ASSISTANT.
translation: {JPN}そらへの みちが ひらけた。\nダークポケモンを 5たい スナッチし\nはかせの じょしゅの もとへ。
{JPN}ポケモンたちの やみは\nいまや あなたに したがう。

raw: "Meet the MINISTER at the\nSHIN-TOKYO docks, then bust\nMikmanc out of the jail."
source: Meet the MINISTER at the\nSHIN-TOKYO docks, then bust\nMikmanc out of the jail.
translation: {JPN}シントウキョウの みなとで\nだいじんと あい ミクマンクを\nろうやから たすけだそう。

raw: "Mikmanc walks free. The\nMinister paid what he owed."
source: Mikmanc walks free. The\nMinister paid what he owed.
translation: {JPN}ミクマンクは じゆうの み。\nだいじんも やくそくを はたした。

source: Meet Lida and Canari in\nHotel Z.
translation: {JPN}ホテル{ENG}Z{JPN}で リダと\nカナリィに あおう。

raw: "You met Lida and Canari\nat Hotel Z."
source: You met Lida and Canari\nat Hotel Z.
translation: {JPN}ホテル{ENG}Z{JPN}で リダと\nカナリィに あった。

source: Two Minutes Is a Long Time

raw: "Bring Mable the Mega Stone\nof every rogue Mega (19).\nAsk her for your tally."
source: Bring Mable the Mega Stone\nof every rogue Mega (19).\nAsk her for your tally.
translation: {JPN}ぼうそうメガ 19しゅの メガストーンを\nモミジに とどけよう。\nあつめた かずも きいてみよう。

raw: "Mable has all 19 samples.\nShe's running her tests."
source: Mable has all 19 samples.\nShe's running her tests.
translation: {JPN}19しゅの サンプルが そろい\nモミジは けんさを はじめた。

raw: "Off-the-charts readings in\nthe rifts. Catch Primal\nGroudon and Primal Kyogre."
source: Off-the-charts readings in\nthe rifts. Catch Primal\nGroudon and Primal Kyogre.
translation: {JPN}さけめで いじょうな はんのう。\nゲンシグラードンと\nゲンシカイオーガを つかまえよう。

raw: "Both Primals are caught.\nMable has their readings."
source: Both Primals are caught.\nMable has their readings.
translation: {JPN}2たいの ゲンシを つかまえた。\nモミジも データを てにいれた。

raw: "Something in the rifts is\nafter the Primals' power.\nCatch Mega Rayquaza."
source: Something in the rifts is\nafter the Primals' power.\nCatch Mega Rayquaza.
translation: {JPN}さけめの なにかが\nゲンシの ちからを ねらっている。\nメガレックウザを つかまえよう。

raw: "Mega Rayquaza is caught.\nThe rifts are calming."
source: Mega Rayquaza is caught.\nThe rifts are calming.
translation: {JPN}メガレックウザを つかまえた。\nさけめも おちつきはじめている。

raw: "The thousand-year ice is\nbreaking. Only Prof. Clarkson\nknows why. Seek him out."
source: The thousand-year ice is\nbreaking. Only Prof. Clarkson\nknows why. Seek him out.
translation: {JPN}せんねんの こおりが われはじめた。\nりゆうを しる クラークソンはかせを\nさがしに いこう。

raw: "Clarkson has called from the\npeak. Climb to STAR SUMMIT,\nwhere the ice finally ends."
source: Clarkson has called from the\npeak. Climb to STAR SUMMIT,\nwhere the ice finally ends.
translation: {JPN}はかせが さんちょうで よんでいる。\nこおりが とぎれる ばしょ\nスターサミットへ のぼろう。

raw: "The mountain has woken. What\ncomes next, no one can say."
source: The mountain has woken. What\ncomes next, no one can say.
translation: {JPN}やまが めざめた。 このさき\nなにが おこるかは だれも しらない。

raw: "A boy in Munen waits for a\nfather lost to the ice. Find\nout what became of him."
source: A boy in Munen waits for a\nfather lost to the ice. Find\nout what became of him.
translation: {JPN}ムネンむらの しょうねんは\nこおりに きえた ちちを まっている。\nなにが あったか たしかめよう。

raw: "His father is alive! Return\nto the village and end the\nboy's long wait."
source: His father is alive! Return\nto the village and end the\nboy's long wait.
translation: {JPN}ちちおやは いきていた！\nむらへ もどり しょうねんに しらせ\nながい まちじかんを おわらせよう。

raw: "The long wait by the lake is\nover. Father and son are\ntogether again."
source: The long wait by the lake is\nover. Father and son are\ntogether again.
translation: {JPN}みずうみでの ながい まちじかんは\nおわった。 おやこは\nふたたび ともに すごしている。

raw: "A Mutrid goon froze the Sennen\nLine's gears solid. Find a way\nto thaw the train."
source: A Mutrid goon froze the Sennen\nLine's gears solid. Find a way\nto thaw the train.
translation: {JPN}ミュートリッドだんが センネンせんの\nはぐるまを こおらせた。\nこおりを とかす ほうほうを さがそう。

raw: "Arcanine's flame thawed the\nSennen Line. The trains run\nonce more."
source: Arcanine's flame thawed the\nSennen Line. The trains run\nonce more.
translation: {JPN}ウインディの ほのおで\nセンネンせんの こおりが とけ\nれっしゃが また はしりだした。

raw: "A breeder in the park raises\nEevee. Prove yourself, and\none may choose you."
source: A breeder in the park raises\nEevee. Prove yourself, and\none may choose you.
translation: {JPN}こうえんの ブリーダーが\nイーブイを そだてている。\nみとめられれば えらばれるかも。

raw: "Eevee chose you. What it\ngrows into is up to you."
source: Eevee chose you. What it\ngrows into is up to you.
translation: {JPN}イーブイは あなたを えらんだ。\nどんな すがたに そだつかは\nあなたしだい。

raw: "A collector in the park wants\na Scyther. He offers one of\nthree rare starters in trade."
source: A collector in the park wants\na Scyther. He offers one of\nthree rare starters in trade.
translation: {JPN}こうえんの コレクターは\nストライクと めずらしい パートナー\n3しゅの どれかを こうかんしたい。

raw: "The collector got his Scyther.\nTreasure the partner he gave\nyou in return."
source: The collector got his Scyther.\nTreasure the partner he gave\nyou in return.
translation: {JPN}ストライクを コレクターに わたした。\nかわりに もらった パートナーを\nたいせつに しよう。

raw: "Master Gen's apprentice lost a\nfinished mask in the tunnel.\nRecover it for him."
source: Master Gen's apprentice lost a\nfinished mask in the tunnel.\nRecover it for him.
translation: {JPN}ゲンししょうの でしが\nできたての めんを トンネルで\nなくした。 さがして あげよう。

raw: "You have the missing mask.\nBring it back to Master Gen\nin Pompeii."
source: You have the missing mask.\nBring it back to Master Gen\nin Pompeii.
translation: {JPN}なくした めんが みつかった。\nポンペイの ゲンししょうに\nとどけよう。

raw: "The mask is home. Master Gen\nkept face, his apprentice\nkept their place."
source: The mask is home. Master Gen\nkept face, his apprentice\nkept their place.
translation: {JPN}めんは ぶじに もどった。\nししょうの めんぼくも\nでしの いばしょも まもられた。
{JPN}おじいさんの さいごの ねがい

raw: "Carry the Catalpa Bow across\nthe water. Play the mourning\nrite at his son's grave."
source: Carry the Catalpa Bow across\nthe water. Play the mourning\nrite at his son's grave.
translation: {JPN}アズサユミを もって みずを わたり\nむすこの はかで\nとむらいの ぎしきを おこなおう。

raw: "The bow sang at the graveside.\nA last wish, carried all the\nway through."
source: The bow sang at the graveside.\nA last wish, carried all the\nway through.
translation: {JPN}はかの まえで ユミが うたった。\nさいごの ねがいは\nさいごまで とどけられた。
{JPN}はかせが のこしたもの

raw: "Clarkson's last wish: destroy\nhis research. Reach his lab\nin Munen and end it."
source: Clarkson's last wish: destroy\nhis research. Reach his lab\nin Munen and end it.
translation: {JPN}けんきゅうを こわしてほしい。\nはかせの さいごの ねがいを はたしに\nムネンの けんきゅうじょへ。

raw: "The research will never fall\ninto the wrong hands. His\nwork ends as he asked."
source: The research will never fall\ninto the wrong hands. His\nwork ends as he asked.
translation: {JPN}けんきゅうが あくようされることは\nもう ない。 はかせの しごとは\nねがったとおりの さいごを むかえた。

raw: "The gym leader's father gave\nyou HOT COCOA. Coax his two\ndaughters home for dinner."
source: The gym leader's father gave\nyou HOT COCOA. Coax his two\ndaughters home for dinner.
translation: {JPN}ジムリーダーの ちちに ココアを\nもらった。 ふたりの むすめを\nゆうしょくに つれもどそう。

raw: "The sisters warmed up and\nheaded home. Dinner is served."
source: The sisters warmed up and\nheaded home. Dinner is served.
translation: {JPN}しまいたちは あたたまり\nいえへ むかった。 ごはんの じかんだ。

raw: "They say a star fell upon this mountain.\pThey say it granted a wish.\pThey say it ended the world.$"
source: They say a star fell upon this mountain.\pThey say it granted a wish.\pThey say it ended the world.$
translation: {JPN}このやまに ほしが おちたという。\pほしは ねがいを かなえたという。\pそして せかいを おわらせたという。$

raw: "Those who survived sealed it away.\pThey sealed the star.\nThey sealed what came with it.\pThey called it the Undying Wish...\pAnd they prayed it would never wake again.$"
source: Those who survived sealed it away.\pThey sealed the star.\nThey sealed what came with it.\pThey called it the Undying Wish...\pAnd they prayed it would never wake again.$
translation: {JPN}いきのこった ひとびとは ふうじた。\pあの ほしを。\nほしと ともに きたものを。\pひとは それを ふめつのねがいと よび\pにどと めざめぬよう いのった。$

raw: "It has been sleeping for one thousand\nyears.\pToday, something disturbs the seal.$"
source: It has been sleeping for one thousand\nyears.\pToday, something disturbs the seal.$
translation: {JPN}それから せんねん。\nねむりは つづいていた。\pだが きょう ふういんが ゆらぐ。$

raw: "Good morning, sleepyhead.\pProfessor Clarkson sent word. \nHe wants to see you at his lab.\pMind the cold. The mist's come down\nearly.$"
source: Good morning, sleepyhead.\pProfessor Clarkson sent word. \nHe wants to see you at his lab.\pMind the cold. The mist's come down\nearly.$
translation: {JPN}おはよう。 よく ねむれた？\pクラークソンはかせから でんごんよ。\nけんきゅうじょに きてほしいって。\pさむいから きをつけてね。\nきょうは もう きりが でているわ。$

raw: "The Professor's waiting at his\nlab, dear. Wrap up warm.$"
source: The Professor's waiting at his\nlab, dear. Wrap up warm.$
translation: {JPN}はかせが けんきゅうじょで まってるわ。\nあたたかくして いくのよ。$

raw:
"There you are.\pI study what this mountain remembers…
its old ice, its stories.\pDeep in the frozen lake I found three
of them. Sleeping in the ice.\pI revived them. I shouldn't have.\pGo on, choose one.
Let it choose you back.$"
source:
There you are.\pI study what this mountain remembers…
its old ice, its stories.\pDeep in the frozen lake I found three
of them. Sleeping in the ice.\pI revived them. I shouldn't have.\pGo on, choose one.
Let it choose you back.$
translation:
{JPN}きたか。\pわしは このやまの きおくを しらべとる。
ふるい こおりや つたわる はなしをな。\pこおった みずうみの そこで みつけた。
こおりの なかで ねむる 3たいを。\pわしが よみがえらせた。 あやまちだった。\pさあ 1たい えらぶがいい。
むこうにも えらんで もらいなさい。$

raw: "It already trusts you. Good.\pYou're holding part of an answer\nthis mountain has kept for a long time.$"
source: It already trusts you. Good.\pYou're holding part of an answer\nthis mountain has kept for a long time.$
translation: {JPN}もう なついたか。 よしよし。\pそのこは やまが ながらく ひめてきた\nこたえの ひとかけらなのだ。$

raw: "Inside the ice, something stirs.\pIt regards you as if it already\nrules here.\pTake this one?$"
source: Inside the ice, something stirs.\pIt regards you as if it already\nrules here.\pTake this one?$
translation: {JPN}こおりの なかで なにかが うごいた。\pまるで ここは じぶんの りょうちだと\nいわんばかりに こちらを みている。\pこのこを えらびますか？$

raw: "Inside the ice, something stirs.\pIt grins at you through the frost,\ndelighted you noticed.\pTake this one?$"
source: Inside the ice, something stirs.\pIt grins at you through the frost,\ndelighted you noticed.\pTake this one?$
translation: {JPN}こおりの なかで なにかが うごいた。\pきづいて もらえて うれしいのか\nしもごしに にっこりと ほほえんだ。\pこのこを えらびますか？$

raw: "Inside the ice, something stirs.\pIt cannot see you, but its jaws\nare already testing the ice.\pTake this one?$"
source: Inside the ice, something stirs.\pIt cannot see you, but its jaws\nare already testing the ice.\pTake this one?$
translation: {JPN}こおりの なかで なにかが うごいた。\pこちらの すがたは みえないようだが\nあごで こおりを たしかめている。\pこのこを えらびますか？$

raw: "The ice cracks.\pIt breathes for the first time in a\nthousand years and chooses to\lbreathe beside you.$"
source: The ice cracks.\pIt breathes for the first time in a\nthousand years and chooses to\lbreathe beside you.$
translation: {JPN}こおりが われた。\pせんねんぶりに いきを すう。\nそして これからも あなたの そばで\lいきていくことを えらんだ。$

raw: "The snow on the mountain\nis melting, child.\pThis snow should never melt. Never.\pDeath is coming to Munen.\pI can feel it in the wind.$"
source: The snow on the mountain\nis melting, child.\pThis snow should never melt. Never.\pDeath is coming to Munen.\pI can feel it in the wind.$
translation: {JPN}やまの ゆきが\nとけておるのじゃ。\pとけては ならぬ ゆきが。 けっしてな。\pムネンに しが せまっておる。\pかぜが そう つげておるわ。$

raw: "Did you hear? Professor\nClarkson found something at the \ltop of the mountain!\pWhat could it be?\pI wanna know but my dad says to stay \nclose to home. No fair!$"
source: Did you hear? Professor\nClarkson found something at the \ltop of the mountain!\pWhat could it be?\pI wanna know but my dad says to stay \nclose to home. No fair!$
translation: {JPN}ねえ きいた？ クラークソンはかせが\nやまの てっぺんで なにかを\lみつけたんだって！\pなんだろうなあ？\pしりたいのに おとうさんは\nとおくに いくなって。 ずるいよ！$

raw:
"My dad went out to ice-fish
on Lake Munen days ago...\pHe still hasn't come home.\pThe ice is thin now and half the lake's
open water already. It isn't safe.\pI keep watching the far shore, but
I can't reach it from here.\pIf you ever find a way across that
water... please. Look for him.$"
source:
My dad went out to ice-fish
on Lake Munen days ago...\pHe still hasn't come home.\pThe ice is thin now and half the lake's
open water already. It isn't safe.\pI keep watching the far shore, but
I can't reach it from here.\pIf you ever find a way across that
water... please. Look for him.$
translation:
{JPN}とうさんが ムネンこへ
こおりづりに いって なんにちもたつ。\pまだ かえってこないんだ。\pこおりは うすいし みずうみの
はんぶんは もう とけてる。 あぶないよ。\pむこうぎしを ずっと みてるけど
ここからじゃ わたれない。\pもし むこうへ わたる ほうほうが
みつかったら おねがい。 さがして。$

raw: "The festival is cancelled this year.\pThe Professor's orders. He says the\nmountain isn't safe right now.\pFirst time we've missed it \nsince I was born.$"
source: The festival is cancelled this year.\pThe Professor's orders. He says the\nmountain isn't safe right now.\pFirst time we've missed it \nsince I was born.$
translation: {JPN}ことしの おまつりは ちゅうしだ。\pはかせの いいつけでね。\nいまの やまは あぶないんだとさ。\pおれが うまれてから\nちゅうしに なったのは はじめてだ。$

raw: "So that's where they went.\pPROFESSOR CLARKSON said he'd left\nsomething for me too! I'm not letting\lyou walk off with all of it.\pI'm taking what's left.\pConsider this a warning,\n{PLAYER}.$"
source: So that's where they went.\pPROFESSOR CLARKSON said he'd left\nsomething for me too! I'm not letting\lyou walk off with all of it.\pI'm taking what's left.\pConsider this a warning,\n{PLAYER}.$
translation: {JPN}なるほど。 ここに いたのか。\pクラークソンはかせが おれの ぶんも\nのこしたって いってたんだ！\lぜんぶ おまえに わたすかよ。\pのこりは おれが もらう。\pわすれるなよ\n{ENG}{PLAYER}{JPN}。$

raw: "Next time we meet…\nwe're settling this.\pSee you on the road.$"
source: Next time we meet…\nwe're settling this.\pSee you on the road.$
translation: {JPN}つぎに あったら\nきっちり けりを つけようぜ。\pじゃあな。 また みちで あおう。$

raw: "Hold up, {PLAYER}!\pYou can't go wandering off the mountain\nempty-handed.\pHere, I came to give you these\nbefore you set out.$"
source: Hold up, {PLAYER}!\pYou can't go wandering off the mountain\nempty-handed.\pHere, I came to give you these\nbefore you set out.$
translation: {JPN}まちなさい {ENG}{PLAYER}{JPN}！\pなにも もたずに やまを おりては\nいかんぞ。\pほれ。 しゅっぱつまえに\nこれを わたしておこうと おもってな。$

raw: "The Poke Balls are for catching\nwild Pokemon, you'll find a few along\lthe northern trail.\pThe Potions are for when your partner\nneeds patching up.\pNow then. Be careful out there.\pAnd write to your mother.$"
source: The Poke Balls are for catching\nwild Pokemon, you'll find a few along\lthe northern trail.\pThe Potions are for when your partner\nneeds patching up.\pNow then. Be careful out there.\pAnd write to your mother.$
translation: {JPN}モンスターボールは やせいの\nポケモンを つかまえるためのものじゃ。\lきたの やまみちにも いるぞ。\pパートナーが きずついたら\nキズぐすりを つかいなさい。\pでは きをつけて いくんじゃぞ。\pおかあさんに てがみも かくんじゃよ。$

raw: "It's not safe to head up the mountain\nyet.\pProfessor Clarkson asked to see you\nbefore you set out, and you'll want\la partner at your side first.$"
source: It's not safe to head up the mountain\nyet.\pProfessor Clarkson asked to see you\nbefore you set out, and you'll want\la partner at your side first.$
translation: {JPN}いま やまを のぼるのは\nまだ あぶない。\pしゅっぱつまえに はかせが\nあいたがっていた。 それに まずは\lパートナーも ひつようだ。$

source: Let's see what that thing\ncan do!$
translation: {JPN}そいつに なにが できるか\nみせてもらおうか！$

raw: "...Heh. Not bad.\pI'll be better next time.$"
source: ...Heh. Not bad.\pI'll be better next time.$
translation: {JPN}⋯へえ。 やるじゃん。\pつぎまでに もっと つよくなるからな。$

raw: "PROFESSOR CLARKSON'S LABORATORY\pIf you can read this from outside,\nhe's probably busy with research.$"
source: PROFESSOR CLARKSON'S LABORATORY\pIf you can read this from outside,\nhe's probably busy with research.$
translation: {JPN}クラークソンはかせの けんきゅうじょ\pそとから これが よめるなら\nはかせは けんきゅうで いそがしいのかも。$

raw: "FORECLOSURE NOTICE\pThis property has been seized.\pThe family who lived here left suddenly.\pNo one in Munen will say where.$"
source: FORECLOSURE NOTICE\pThis property has been seized.\pThe family who lived here left suddenly.\pNo one in Munen will say where.$
translation: {JPN}さしおさえの おしらせ\pこの ふどうさんは さしおさえられました。\pすんでいた かぞくは とつぜん たちさった。\pどこへ いったのか むらの だれも かたらない。$

raw: "My old man's finally home!\pHe came back babbling about a RED\nGYARADOS and the trainer who faced it.\pI thought he'd lost it in that cave…\nguess he was telling the truth.\pThank you for bringing him back to us.$"
source: My old man's finally home!\pHe came back babbling about a RED\nGYARADOS and the trainer who faced it.\pI thought he'd lost it in that cave…\nguess he was telling the truth.\pThank you for bringing him back to us.$
translation: {JPN}とうさんが やっと かえってきたよ！\pあかい ギャラドスと それに たちむかった\nトレーナーの はなしばっかり してる。\pどうくつで おかしくなったかと おもったけど\nほんとうの はなしだったんだね。\pとうさんを つれもどしてくれて ありがとう。$

raw: "Wait… THERE he is!\pSon, that's the guy! That's the one\nwho took on the RED GYARADOS!\pI'd know that face anywhere. I haven't\nstopped shaking since that cave.$"
source: Wait… THERE he is!\pSon, that's the guy! That's the one\nwho took on the RED GYARADOS!\pI'd know that face anywhere. I haven't\nstopped shaking since that cave.$
translation: {JPN}まてよ⋯ あのときの！\pおい このひとだ！ このひとが\nあかい ギャラドスに たちむかったんだ！\pあのかおは わすれない。 どうくつを\nでてからも ずっと ふるえが とまらんよ。$

raw: "So it's true… you really landed it.\pListen… I know it's a lot to ask,\nbut that GYARADOS was my life's dream.\pWould you… would you be willing to\ngive it to me?$"
source: So it's true… you really landed it.\pListen… I know it's a lot to ask,\nbut that GYARADOS was my life's dream.\pWould you… would you be willing to\ngive it to me?$
translation: {JPN}ほんとうに⋯ あいつを つかまえたのか。\pむりな おねがいだとは おもうが\nあの ギャラドスは おれの ゆめだった。\pよかったら⋯ おれに\nゆずっては もらえないだろうか？$

raw: "Heh… figured I'd ask.\pThat's an incredible reward.\nYou deserve to keep it.$"
source: Heh… figured I'd ask.\pThat's an incredible reward.\nYou deserve to keep it.$
translation: {JPN}はは⋯ きくだけ きいてみたのさ。\pすごい えものだ。\nきみが もっているべきだよ。$

raw: "You… you'd really part with it?\pI don't have much, but a fisherman\nalways keeps something for the big one.\pPlease - take this. I want you to have it.$"
source: You… you'd really part with it?\pI don't have much, but a fisherman\nalways keeps something for the big one.\pPlease - take this. I want you to have it.$
translation: {JPN}ほんとうに⋯ ゆずってくれるのか？\pたいした ものは ないが つりびとは\nおおもののための そなえを してるもんだ。\pこれを うけとってくれ。 きみに やるよ。$

raw: "You faced it down all the same…\nthat's more guts than I'll ever have.\pA catch like that wasn't meant for a\ncoward like me. But you earned this.\pTake it. I insist.$"
source: You faced it down all the same…\nthat's more guts than I'll ever have.\pA catch like that wasn't meant for a\ncoward like me. But you earned this.\pTake it. I insist.$
translation: {JPN}それでも きみは たちむかった⋯\nおれには まねできない ゆうきだ。\pあんな えものは おくびょうな おれには\nふつりあいさ。 だが これは きみのものだ。\pうけとってくれ。 えんりょは なしだ。$

raw: "Hold on now - that's your only\nPOKéMON! I can't take that from you.\pHang onto it. Come find me if you\never change your mind.$"
source: Hold on now - that's your only\nPOKéMON! I can't take that from you.\pHang onto it. Come find me if you\never change your mind.$
translation: {JPN}ちょっとまて。 そのこが きみの\nさいごの 1ぴきだろう！ もらえないよ。\pだいじに するんだぞ。 また きが\nかわったら おれの ところへ きてくれ。$

raw: "Every morning I watch the water and\nthink about that day.\pThank you, {PLAYER}. Truly.$"

translation: {JPN}まいあさ みずうみを ながめては\nあのひのことを おもいだすんだ。\pありがとう {ENG}{PLAYER}{JPN}。 ほんとうに。$
